message: `{operator}` must be a top-level additive term of a contribution
description: Its gain is a complex number that depends on frequency, so it can only be applied to a whole contribution, where it is realized as a filter with its own state. Inside an ordinary expression there is nowhere to put it.
actions: Contribute the filter on its own, as one term of the `<+` right-hand side: `V(out) <+ {operator}(...);`.
If it must be scaled or combined, filter into an internal node first and use that node's potential in the expression.
